name: Proxmox_VE_Info
description: Reads the Proxmox VE version, release and cluster membership of a cluster or node resource. Sets no category.
technicalNotes:
Applies to resources that carry ProxmoxVE_Cluster or ProxmoxVE_Node, the categories the NetScan (or a user adding a resource by hand) sets. It sets no category itself, and calls /version and /cluster/status with the configured token. There is no addCategory_* PropertySource in the suite; the product page lists the categories for a resource added by hand.

It sets auto.pve.version, auto.pve.release where present, auto.pve.clustered and auto.pve.cluster.name. The script prints the keys without the auto. prefix; LogicMonitor adds it to every property a PropertySource sets, so an AppliesTo must use the auto. names.

Silent -- exit 0, no output -- when the token is missing or the API does not answer, so a resource that cannot be read gets no stale facts.

Unlike addERI_Proxmox_VE_Node this is a plain PropertySource: no propertySourceType and no collectionInterval, matching a published addCategory_* export. It uses no Collector-only classes, so it compiles and runs in the test harness like the DataSources.

Requires Sys.Audit on / for /cluster/status, which the PVEAuditor role includes; /version needs only authentication.
